up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for Callithrix jacchus, including substrate and parent compound names, SMILES, conversion details, pathway, and enzyme.
sql:
SELECT
  met.met_id,
  COALESCE(substrate_cr.compound_name, substr_md.pref_name) AS substrate_name,
  COALESCE(parent_cr.compound_name, parent_md.pref_name) AS parent_name,
  substr_cs.canonical_smiles,
  met.met_conversion,
  met.pathway_key,
  met.enzyme_name
FROM metabolism met
LEFT JOIN compound_records substrate_cr ON met.substrate_record_id = substrate_cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary substr_md ON substrate_cr.molregno = substr_md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures substr_cs ON substr_md.molregno = substr_cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records parent_cr ON met.drug_record_id = parent_cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary parent_md ON parent_cr.molregno = parent_md.molregno
WHERE met.organism = 'Callithrix jacchus'
ORDER BY met.met_id
LIMIT 200;
